title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2608.27296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.   The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less

translated_title: 大语言模型能够设计近乎最优的运筹学算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27296v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：我们探究大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够为定义明确的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效的算法。我们研究了库存控制、排队网络控制和分类优化问题。我们评估了LLM使用的两个层级：在第一层级，模型接收单个问题实例并为该实例返回解决方案；在第二层级，模型仅接收问题类别描述和广泛的参数范围，并返回一个将实例参数映射到解决方案的算法。人工输入极少：我们提供一个未经调整的提示来描述问题，模型可以使用带有固定计算预算的Python沙盒工具。我们测试的最强模型gpt-5.6-sol，在几乎所有评估实例上匹配或超越了现有最佳方法。即使在第二层级，即在看到评估实例之前返回的算法已固定的情况下，这一结论也成立。性能也随着新发布模型的迭代而显著提升。
tldr: 大语言模型（如gpt-5.6-sol）能够仅凭少量提示和固定计算资源，自动设计出在库存控制、排队网络和分类优化等问题上匹配或超越现有最佳方法的近乎最优运筹学算法。
en_tdlr: Large language models (e.g., gpt-5.6-sol) can automatically design near-optimal operations research algorithms that match or outperform existing best methods on inventory control, queueing network, and assortment optimization problems, with minimal human input and fixed compute resources.
